Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.
Act as an independent-prompt defender of each candidate. Search every allowed namesake for positive support before calling a role error. A source explicitly saying a person plays rugby supports that sport. Missing credibility metadata is not wrong_argument.
